env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A two-target receive whose frozen index calls another matched method:
# the inner cast must compose into the outer cast text, so the store
# rewrite drains one splice and native and ejected builds agree.

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_nested_recv.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_nested_recv.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_nested_recv.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/cswselectnestedrecv

go 1.27
